import bpy, os, json, shutil, numpy as np, importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent
cap=root/'captures/shipyard_painterly_20261112'
cap.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
assert not (cap/'resume_before.blend').exists()
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(cap/'resume_before.blend'),copy=True)
shutil.copy2(root/'assets/coast/shipyard_combined.glb',cap/'resume_before.glb')
mats={s.material for o in list(bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft'].objects)+list(bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Export'].objects) for s in o.material_slots if s.material}
out=[]
for m in sorted(mats,key=lambda m:m.name):
 p=next(n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type=='BSDF_PRINCIPLED')
 entry={'name':m.name,'base':list(p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value),'rough':p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value,'metal':p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value,'normal':[n.inputs['Strength'].default_value for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type=='NORMAL_MAP'],'images':[]}
 for n in m.node_tree.nodes:
  if n.type!='TEX_IMAGE' or not n.image:continue
  im=n.image
  entry['images'].append({'name':im.name,'file':im.filepath,'space':im.colorspace_settings.name,'size':list(im.size),'links':[(l.to_node.name,l.to_socket.name) for l in n.outputs['Color'].links]})
 out.append(entry)
report={'pid':os.getpid(),'file':bpy.data.filepath,'pil':bool(importlib.util.find_spec('PIL')),'materials':out}
(cap/'resume_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
print(json.dumps(report))
